checklist_item: b39n8-01-01 blank vs zero: P0-P2 medians
claim_as_stated: DAFRC records 0 on 86 blank-filed FY2023 sponsor-years (81 with assets > 0) and 52 zero-filed (51); applying IPS's rule (drop the 81) moves the panel median from 9.33% to 9.8587% (n=1,400), 0.18 points above IPS.
validation_result: confirmed: raw XML of the 138 panel primary returns gives 86 without the element (81 with assets > 0) and 52 with 0 (51 with assets > 0); recomputed P0 9.3297% (1,481), P1 10.1929% (1,349, unscreened), P2 9.8587% (1,400)
exact_values_found: P2 9.8587% n=1,400; bridge screened grants>0 10.1981% n=1,344 (PB2152) = the 10.20% bound; unscreened 10.1929%
discrepancies: none; note the 10.20% in the bridge is the IPS-screened variant and the unscreened bound is 10.19%

checklist_item: b39n8-01-01 blank vs zero: 127 of 197 consistent with no grants; 55 > 10%
claim_as_stated: For 197 blank-filed sponsors with prior assets > 0, 127 have implied outflow <= 0 (compatible with no grants) and 55 above 10% of prior assets; blank is probably zero for most.
validation_result: partially confirmed: numbers reproduce independently from raw line 2(a)/4(a) and IPS FY2022 assets (197; 127; 55; 35 exactly 0; median 0.0%; 7 use the filed FY2022 fallback); the 'probably zero for most' reading is not supported by this test
interpretation_challenge: the roll-forward ignores investment return; most FY2023 periods had positive market returns [I], so a fund paying grants roughly equal to its gains shows outflow <= 0; outflow <= 0 is necessary, not sufficient, for zero grants; 35 exact zeros and 28 identical year-on-year asset values suggest stale or carried-forward entries rather than evidence of no grants

checklist_item: b39n8-01-01 blank vs zero: is blank-filed vs zero-filed a meaningful distinction
claim_as_stated: Blank-filed (element absent) and zero-filed (element = 0) are distinct classes; whether blank means zero cannot be read from Schedule D.
validation_result: partially confirmed: the distinction is real in the data (explicit DonorAdvisedFundsGrantsAmt = 0 on 103 distinct returns read: 100 IPS zeros + 3 panel-only), so the schema does not force omission of zeros; MeF accepted 256 distinct returns (248 IPS blanks + 8 panel-only) without the element, so it is optional; every one of the 248 blank-filed returns contains other explicit zero-valued elements, and 1 blank-filer wrote 0 on line 2(a) while leaving 3(a) blank; the XSD itself was not read
exact_values_found: explicit 0 on 103/103 distinct zero-cell returns; element absent on 256 distinct returns; other zero elements present in 248/248 blank-filed returns
interpretation_challenge: absence records a preparer or software choice for that line, not a separate fact about grants; the distinction is meaningful for provenance (IPS copies it faithfully) but not as evidence that blank-filers made or did not make grants
